proof_summary: Direct divisor enumeration evaluates every claimed witness and rules out all smaller candidates except in the large value- case. There, divisor reflection forces any smaller hypothetical example to have least prime factor at least \(17\) and at most four distinct prime factors; AM–GM on reciprocal adjacent-divisor products, combined with the multiplicative bound \(\sum_{d\mid n}d^{-2}\le\prod_{q\mid n}q^2/(q^2-1)\), yields \(s/n^2\le 1/15\), contradicting \(\lfloor n^2/s\rfloor=14\).
